evidence.description: Unstructured task created via DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter without lifecycle management or cancellation handle.

candidates.explanation: The `handlePageLoadCompletion` method creates an unstructured `DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter` task that captures `self` weakly but has no visible mechanism to cancel or manage its lifecycle if the operation is superseded or the manager is deallocated before the 0.5-second delay completes.
candidates.title: Unstructured Concurrency Without Appropriate Lifecycle Management
